ننتقض (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِضُ (nantaqiḍu) /nan.ta.qi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# نَنْتَقِضَ (nantaqiḍa) /nan.ta.qi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# نَنْتَقِضْ (nantaqiḍ) /nan.ta.qidˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
